description: This PHP source file defines a class 'CaseUpdatesHook' that implements various hooks and methods for handling case updates within a SuiteCRM module. The class includes logic for saving updates, attaching files, linking accounts, sending notification emails for case closure and creation, handling email updates, and filtering HTML. It interacts with external files such as 'util.php', 'AOPAssignManager.php', and other SuiteCRM core components, making it integral to case update workflows.

classes.name: CaseUpdatesHook
classes.description: A class implementing hooks for handling case updates, email notifications, status changes, and related workflows in a SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: getAssignToUser
methods.description: Retrieves the next user to assign a case update to, via 'AOPAssignManager'.

methods.name: arrangeFilesArray
methods.description: Reorganizes the $_FILES array for uploaded files related to case updates.

methods.name: saveUpdate
methods.description: Saves a case update, including handling files and notes attachments, and assigning the case.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Creates a new Note bean linked to a case update.

methods.name: linkAccountAndCase
methods.description: Links a case with an account based on provided IDs.

methods.name: assignAccount
methods.description: Assigns an account to a case based on related contact information.

methods.name: saveEmailUpdate
methods.description: Creates a case update from an email, linking contacts, and attaching notes.

methods.name: updateCaseStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a case based on configuration mappings.

methods.name: unquoteEmail
methods.description: Removes email reply delimiters and decodes HTML entities from email text.

methods.name: closureNotifyPrep
methods.description: Prepares a case for closure notification by setting email flags.

methods.name: closureNotify
methods.description: Sends a closure notification email if the case is closed.

methods.name: sendClosureEmail
methods.description: Constructs and sends a closure email using a template.

methods.name: creationNotify
methods.description: Sends an email notification when a contact is related to a case.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Populates an email template with case and contact data.

methods.name: getAOPConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the AOP configuration from global settings.

methods.name: sendCreationEmail
methods.description: Sends an email when a new case is created and linked to a contact.

methods.name: logEmail
methods.description: Logs sent email details into the Emails module.

methods.name: filterHTML
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML content in a case's description.

methods.name: sendCaseUpdate
methods.description: Dispatches email notifications for a case update, respecting configuration and context.
